summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the NEW sub-pages + moved Export-PDF-to-ellipsis features. 12/13 flows pass. Only failure is flow #8: the FIRST click on the sidebar note-toggle arrow does NOT expand sub-pages (requires 2 clicks). Second click works and expands correctly. All other flows work end-to-end: ellipsis menu has both Add-sub-page and Export-as-PDF, inline 'Add a sub-page' button, navigation, sidebar nesting, recursive delete of children when parent deleted, and folder+note+sub-page tree rendering.

ui_bugs.issue: First click on note-toggle-{id} is a no-op. Sub-pages only appear after a SECOND click. Root cause: `toggle` does `setExpanded(p => ({ ...p, [id]: p[id] === false }))`. For notes, `isOpen = expanded[\`note_${note.id}\`] === true` (default collapsed). Initial state is undefined. First click: `undefined === false` → false → `expanded[key] = false`. isOpen then evaluates `false === true` → still false → still collapsed. Second click: `false === false` → true → expands. Note: the previous iteration_2 fix was correct for folders (which use `isOpen = expanded[id] !== false`, default-open) but introduces the symmetric off-by-one for notes which are default-collapsed and check `=== true`.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Unify the toggle logic in components/Sidebar.jsx so it works for BOTH notes (default collapsed, `=== true`) AND folders (default open, `!== false`). Recommended: track explicit boolean initialized based on context, e.g. `toggle(id, defaultOpen)` and do `setExpanded(p => ({ ...p, [id]: p[id] === undefined ? !defaultOpen : !p[id] }))`. OR simplest: change note-toggle to call `setExpanded(p => ({ ...p, [`note_${id}`]: !(p[`note_${id}`] === true) }))` while keeping folder toggle as-is. OR: rename and split into two handlers (toggleFolder vs toggleNote). Verified via test: clicks 1,2,3 produce sidebar item counts 1,3,1 instead of expected 3,1,3.
(Carried over from iteration_1) NoteEditor.jsx imports Underline extension which is already part of Tiptap v3 StarterKit → console warning on every note load.
(Carried over) SearchDialog.jsx missing DialogTitle/Description → Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx toggle(id) is ambiguous because folders and notes have opposite default states (folders default-open, notes default-collapsed) but share the same `expanded` map and the same `toggle` function. Any single boolean-flip rule will be off-by-one for one of them on the first click. Needs either separate handlers or stored default-awareness.
storage.deleteNote correctly recurses and deletes all descendant parentNoteId chains (verified: parent + 2 children → 0 remaining).

storage.createNote takes (folderId, parentNoteId) correctly; sub-page inherits parent's folderId via App.handleCreateNote which passes selectedNote.folderId — verified via flow #13 (folder-Note + Folder-Sub both have same folderId, and Folder-Sub.parentNoteId = Folder-Note.id).
NoteEditor.jsx: subPages filter `allNotes.filter(n => n.parentNoteId === note.id)` is O(N) per render — fine for localStorage scale but consider memoizing if lists grow.
NoteEditor.jsx ellipsis DropdownMenu at top-right uses z-10 which is sufficient; no overlay collisions observed.

html2pdf export path removes the temp container in a finally-adjacent block inside try — if html2pdf throws, the injected DOM element remains. Consider wrapping in try/finally around save() to always remove the container.

rca of the issue:
Note-toggle first-click no-op RCA:
  Reproduction: 1) Clear localStorage. 2) Create parent note 'Parent Note'. 3) Click ellipsis → Add sub-page → title 'Child 1'. 4) Navigate to parent, click inline 'Add a sub-page' → title 'Child 2'. 5) Navigate to parent (parent in sidebar now has toggle arrow). 6) Click note-toggle-{parent_id} ONCE → sub-pages NOT visible (BUG, count stays at 1). 7) Click again → sub-pages appear (count=3). 8) Click again → collapse (count=1).
  Root cause: Sidebar.jsx `const toggle = useCallback((id) => setExpanded(p => ({ ...p, [id]: p[id] === false })), [])` was fixed in iteration_2 for folders (isOpen = expanded[id] !== false, default-open). But notes use `isOpen = expanded['note_'+note.id] === true` (default-collapsed). For notes, undefined→false→isOpen=false (no visible change); only second click (false→true) toggles.
  Mitigation: Either (a) use two toggles: `toggleFolder` keeps current logic; `toggleNote` uses `p[id] !== true` so first click undefined→true→isOpen=true (expands). Or (b) store explicit boolean in state based on default: `[id]: p[id] === undefined ? true : !p[id]` for notes, `[id]: p[id] === undefined ? false : !p[id]` for folders.
  Verified via sidebar item counts across 3 sequential clicks: 1 → 1 → 3 (expected 3 → 1 → 3).
